'''Quilladin Stands''' (Japanese: '''ハリボーグ、立つ''' ''{{tt|Hariborg|Quilladin}}, Stand'') is the 577th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 29th chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Korrina]], the [[Vaniville Town]] residents, and {{tc|Sky Trainer}}s are taken to a hospital in [[Laverre City]] to recuperate.
* [[Valerie]], [[Olympia]], and [[Grant]] come to visit Korrina, but soon leave to meet with [[Wulfric]] and [[Ramos]].
* {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} {{pkmn|training|train}} with [[Gurkinn]].
* {{adv|X}}, blaming himself for what happened to Korrina, holes himself at the base of a large tree.
* [[Marisso]] and [[Salamè]] evolve into {{p|Quilladin}} and {{p|Charmeleon}}, respectively.
* [[Xerosic]] presents [[Lysandre]] with a Mega Ring fitted with Korrina's [[Key Stone]] and the Lysandre Machine created by [[Clemont]].
* Having no more use for him, Xerosic throws Clemont down a garbage incineration chute.
* X receives a telepathic message from [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] assuring him to not give up and aim to fix his mistake.
* {{p|Klefki}} presents X with Clemont's glasses, which show an image of [[Geosenge Town]].
* X realizes that Clemont is in [[Team Flare Secret HQ]], and sets off to Geosenge Town to stop Team Flare.
